race.comment: JACKPOT PARK (1) also resumes with two placings from two starts and has trialled twice, including a close second at Flemington. Looks primed for a bold showing in his first run for the new stable. Can make an impression. SABRINA (9) showed enough on debut without winning and has trialled nicely since that effort. Blinkers go on now and she can feature. VALENTINA GIRL (10) is another with the blinkers on for the first time and can play a leading role from an inside barrier. IRISH ECLIPSE (7) debutant with recent Pakenham trial work and a $140,000 yearling tag. Watch the markets for any confidence.
